name: Mikloth
title: Benjamite in Gibeon
summary: Mikloth was a Benjamite mentioned in Chronicles as part of Saul's genealogy. He was the son of Jeiel (the father of Gibeon) and the father of Shimea (also called Shimma). He belonged to the prominent family in Gibeon that was linked to King Saul's lineage.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in Saul's Genealogy
keyEvents.description: Miclot is listed as part of the Benjaminite genealogy leading to King Saul, showing his place in this important family.

keyEvents.title: Son of Jehiel from Gibeon
keyEvents.description: Miclot is identified as the son of Jehiel, father of Gibeon, and his wife Maakah, thus connecting him to the leading family in Gibeon.

keyEvents.title: Father of Shimea
keyEvents.description: Miclot was the father of Shimea (Shimeah), who continued the lineage in the tribe of Benjamin.

keyEvents.title: Repeated in Chronicles' Genealogical Record
keyEvents.description: Miclot's place in the genealogy is repeated in 1 Chronicles chapter 9, emphasizing the family's significance in Israel's history.

keyEvents.title: Part of Gibeon's Leading Family
keyEvents.description: As a member of Jehiel's family in Gibeon, Miclot was part of an influential Benjaminite clan living near Jerusalem.
